MatchedObjectDescriptor.PositionTitle: Summer Internship Program in Biomedical Research
MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: Applicants must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents and must be enrolled at least half-time in an accredited graduate or undergraduate program.

Details.JobSummary: Research training in genomics, single-cell analysis and computational biology within the NIH Intramural Research Program.
MajorDuties: Present findings at the NIH Summer Poster Day
Details.Education: Graduate students are eligible. Students must be 17 years of age or older.
